title: Disappointed
body: I originally grabbed this app, as a/ it synched across multiple devices b/ it was simple, it did exactly what it said and little else. Now, what was once a useful tool because of it's dedication to one task - keeping a list of things to do synched across multiple devices - has now become another over-complicated, over-styled piece of software whose use in performing the task it replaced from the 'real world' is no longer more efficient than the original way of performing the task, and is actually less efficient the majority of the time. Technology should help improve our lives by freeing time, or allowing us to achieve things we might not be able to otherwise. It should NOT give us less time, or make it more difficult to achieve things. Microsoft mostly come down on the right side of this equation...but they seem to be blind to the times they don't. Sadly, the over-complication of what was a very useful, very simple app here, is an example of one of those times, in my opinion. The synch capability is useful, but you can find it in many apps now that would allow you to keep a to do list across all devices i.e. notes on Vivaldi browser, so there are plenty of less complicated ways of keeping the same info synched.

title: 1 STEP AWAY from being the best productivity app ever created
body:
Every feature of the app is great, there is all but one thing lacking: 

a CALENDAR VIEW for your “planned” tasks.

if they could simply add a calendar view for the “planned” tasks, it can completely replace google calendar and everything else on the market, a calendar view helps me to get a good perspective of time and appreciate the relative timing between different tasks, while just having the date displayed in a text format is frustrating and quite unhelpful.
One suggestion while implementing this feature would be to also add a “drag and drop” feature, so perhaps you can even drag existing tasks onto a day in the calendar, so that task would then be set to be either “due or reminded” at that particular time and day.
